## Power
For the Round 1 Power, take [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b) for its incredible flexibility and potency. Even without any Cooldown Reduction, you will usually get 2-3 Suzus per teamfight, compared to the usual 1-2. Even when not facing debuff-heavy heroes like [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1), [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000), etc., having more Suzus available is always useful, both for winning fights and for Stadium Cash income.

## Items
For maximum Stadium Cash income, take [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), and [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318).

For maximum survivability, take [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) and [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6).

Two Cash items alongside one survivability item can also work.

If you prefer some other combination of Round 1 Items, that's also fine. It really doesn't matter too much what Items you take in the first round.

In Round 2, you should still focus on Weapon Items, because you only have one Power and we don't have enough Stadium Cash to make this build's Ability Items shine yet. [Teamwork Toolkit](item_d56fb90c-cbe6-4ad5-8475-0ce920f92a3f) and  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) have the best overall value, and work well together.

At normal Stadium Cash levels (12000+), you will be able to get both of these Items alongside three Common Items. If you have a tremendous amount of Stadium Cash from Round 1, it is possible to get a third Rare Item while still obtaining a couple Common Items. In general, a generic Rare Item is worth about two Common Items in terms of overall stats but costs more than both combined, so balance your Item purchases around that.

As before, Common Items should be taken in order of which offer the best possible Stadium Cash income: [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf), and [Plasma Converter](item_25869f9a-9a29-4e19-96b6-9d8a28c59318). If you really need the extra survivability, however, you can still take [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) and/or [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6).

## Power
For the Round 3 Power, you take [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3). The clone won't be very strong yet, but it still offers valuable Stadium Cash income through its healing, and can mitigate some incoming damage simply by existing and being an additional target. Additionally, because you now have the clone, you want to start building [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) (for better Suzu and clone uptime) and [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) (for more Suzu healing and clone HP).


## Items
Depending on your Stadium Cash, there are two paths. Both paths always start with [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b).

### Path 1
If you have at least 28,000 Stadium Cash, you will orient the build to focus on Kitsune Rush, with [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f) as the centerpiece. With this item, Kitsune Rush goes from strong to oppressive, making it difficult to lose a fight with a well-placed and well-timed Kitsune Rush.

Because Kitsune Rush accumulates value over time (and [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f) plays into that), you want it to last as long as possible. Enter [Eye of the Yokai](item_60d1abaa-e0df-4911-b190-b663cfa3e0c7), which slightly increases the healing from both [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) and [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f) via [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and *significantly* increases the duration of Kitsune Rush.

Finally, because Kitsune Rush is your big fight winner, you want [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c) to gain an early Ultimate advantage, which can snowball into a permanent Ultimate advantage - and also a Stadium Cash advantage.

After purchasing these four Items, spend any leftover Stadium Cash first on increasing [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction), then on increasing [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), and finally on maximizing Stadium Cash income.

### Path 2
If you have less than 28,000 Stadium Cash, you simply want to maximize your Cooldown Reduction. After Donut Delivery, the relevant items offering Cooldown Reduction at this stage are (in order of decreasing CDR and then Stadium Cash cost):
[Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f), [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56), and [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0).

After maximizing Cooldown Reduction, use your leftover Stadium Cash to fill the remaining Item spots with leftover Rare and/or Common Items, prioritizing Stadium Cash income.

If you didn't have enough Stadium Cash to switch to a Kitsune Rush build last round, you definitely should by now. If you already swapped over, keep following the same instructions. If not, here they are again:

You will orient the build to focus on Kitsune Rush, with [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f) as the centerpiece. With this item, Kitsune Rush goes from strong to oppressive, making it difficult to lose a fight with a well-placed and well-timed Kitsune Rush.

Because Kitsune Rush accumulates value over time (and [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f) plays into that), you want it to last as long as possible. Enter [Eye of the Yokai](item_60d1abaa-e0df-4911-b190-b663cfa3e0c7), which slightly increases the healing from both [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b) and [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f) via [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and *significantly* increases the duration of Kitsune Rush.

Finally, because Kitsune Rush is your big fight winner, you want [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c) to gain an early Ultimate advantage, which can snowball into a permanent Ultimate advantage - and also a Stadium Cash advantage.

## Powers
In Round 5, you have a lot of choices for the next Power:
- If the enemy has builds that apply many debuffs frequently (i.e. most [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1) builds, a [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) or [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18) with Cybervenom, a Dynamite [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54), etc.), [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) is a good pickup, because it will significantly accelerate your Ultimate charge.
- If enemies aren't going for debuff-heavy builds AND your teammates' builds benefit greatly from [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed), take [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198). The clone's Healing Ofuda can also apply the attack speed buff, which means the buff can get good uptime even across multiple allies.
- If neither [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) nor [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) will get significant value, [Crossing Guard](item_bb5252fd-fc6b-4dce-a60a-21b0a0add68f) leans further into the accumulating value of Kitsune Rush, making it even harder to escape.
- [Spirit Veil](item_1772ce7d-37ed-41e4-8bac-d9b260aa59ad) is a high-risk, high-reward alternative to [Crossing Guard](item_bb5252fd-fc6b-4dce-a60a-21b0a0add68f), requiring you to find a way to get into the middle of or behind the enemy team without dying to unleash your Kitsune Rush. If you manage to do this successfully, it will create a ton of noise and chaos, and you can get a lot done in those 4 seconds of invulnerability.

## Items
You should still have the core of [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b), [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f), [Eye of the Yokai](item_60d1abaa-e0df-4911-b190-b663cfa3e0c7), and [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c). After these, keep going down the same path as before, prioritizing [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and then [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).

The best items depend on what Power you chose this round and how the game is going:
- If you chose [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) or want more Ability healing, [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) is perfect, offering [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), further boosting the value of your Suzus and your Kitsune Rush. The Rare alternative is [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56).
- If you chose [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) or want more Ofuda healing or Kunai damage, [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448) empowers your buff-laden Healing Ofuda to heal more, and lets you do more damage. The Rare alternative is [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f).
- If you need a bit of extra tankiness, [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) is a great option, offering a small HP boost, [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction), and some self-healing. The Rare alternative is [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0).
- If you need even more tankiness, [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) is your best bet, with 50 Armor and a self-heal every time you use an ability.

If you're really rolling in money, you can even pick up two of the aforementioned Epic Items. Otherwise, take one Epic Item and fill the remaining slot with an approprite Rare or Common Item.

By now, you should have accumulated enough Stadium Cash for a full loadout of [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b), [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f), [Eye of the Yokai](item_60d1abaa-e0df-4911-b190-b663cfa3e0c7), [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c), [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e), and [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448), with any necessary substitutions as previously mentioned (or as you find to be appropriate).

If you have enough excess Stadium Cash, you can now look at replacing one of the two Rare Items. If you have [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68), it's usually better to replace [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c). If you don't have [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68), I still generally prefer to drop [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c) first, but it depends on the game. I leave it up to your judgement and experience to determine which is better to drop. As for what to replace them with:
- If you aren't struggling to survive, [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) is fantastic, essentially offering 10% [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) and 25% [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) permanently, due to the frequency and ease of dealing Weapon Damage and Healing with Kiriko.
- If you need a bit of extra tankiness, [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) is great, offering a small HP boost, [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction), and some self-healing.
- If you need even more tankiness, [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) is your best bet, with 50 Armor and a self-heal every time you use an ability.

Round 7! Your build won't change after this point, so be sure you know what builds your allies and the enemy team are running.

## Powers
A lot of options with largely the same reasoning as last time (but with one exception!):
- If you don't already have [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68) and the enemy won a round with debuff-heavy builds in Round 5 or 6, chances are they'll try that again.
- If you don't already have [Supported Shooting](item_4a084906-0fcd-4158-9a4b-763a69d0b198) and your allies benefit greatly from [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed), take it.
- If you chose one of the above options in Round 5 and the other is not appropriate now, [Crossing Guard](item_bb5252fd-fc6b-4dce-a60a-21b0a0add68f) is easily accessible and guaranteed value. But...
- Last, but certainly not least, the spicy option: [Fleet Foot](item_1d58371c-71a9-44c2-8d5a-0663467599e9). At this point, you have everything you need to make this Power work (most notably, [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b) and the Stadium Cash to buy lots of [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction)), and nobody will expect the Kiriko to start teleporting behind them after seeing her play a Suzu/Kitsune Rush build for 6 rounds. It's a fantastic surprise tactic and can help you swing crucial fights, but requires a good sense of timing and careful cooldown management. One great strategy is to build Kitsune Rush, teleport behind the enemy team, and then use Kitsune Rush *through* the enemy to your own team. It will make a ton of noise and throw the enemy team into chaos. You'll get the most value from [Fleet Foot](item_1d58371c-71a9-44c2-8d5a-0663467599e9) if you chose [Spirit Veil](item_1772ce7d-37ed-41e4-8bac-d9b260aa59ad) in Round 5, but it's far from a dealbreaker if you didn't.

## Items
As usual, it depends on your choice of Power.

If you're taking [Fleet Foot](item_1d58371c-71a9-44c2-8d5a-0663467599e9), drop Items until you just have [Our Bikes](item_d9fa8542-237e-49d5-b6a1-4e910d5c777f), [Donut Delivery](item_296adb69-d517-4885-903a-ef8f3a1d6a7b), [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e), and [Hardlight Accelerator](item_0390c8af-2a68-4da2-b876-93da32c3f448). Pick up [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) as your 5th item, for that extra [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and tankiness boost when diving the backline. For your 6th Item, you want something that will help you secure a surprise backline assassination as quickly as possible. [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) can be really good, offering a strong up-front burst of Kunai damage - but will fall off quickly if you cannot secure an elimination in a few shots. For more consistent damage, [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) or [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) are best. If those are too expensive, simply choose whatever Item you can afford that offers the highest damage, or take [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) for a tiny bit of extra [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) alongside [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power). If you're not confident you can survive a backline dive with a full-damage Item, take [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643).

If you're not going for [Fleet Foot](item_1d58371c-71a9-44c2-8d5a-0663467599e9), things are simpler. If you didn't already do this last round, drop one of your two Rare Items (which should be [Eye of the Yokai](item_60d1abaa-e0df-4911-b190-b663cfa3e0c7) and [Junker Whatchamajig](item_b81ebab8-5c85-405a-b28d-2496de33cd9c)) for [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b). Then, if you can still afford to drop the other Rare Item for an Epic Item, these are some good options:
- [Talisman of Velocity](item_9b81fbe9-c5f8-4442-93d5-082b036010a1) is strong and versatile, giving a substantial buff to any allies hit by your Suzu.
- As usual, If you want a small survivability boost and even more [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction), [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) is great.
- If you want a larger survivability boost, [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) is good.
- If you need a huge survivability boost, drop [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) and take both [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) and [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d). These two items have fantastic synergy and make you *significantly* more durable. Your damage and healing will drop, but you can't help your team if you're dead.
